verdict.rationale: doola documents a compliance calendar API that lists the recurring obligations it tracks to keep a company in good standing. It also offers an annual-report filing API that an agent can follow to completion, so an agent can poll for upcoming filing deadlines. However, the documented webhooks only cover formation and EIN milestones, and no explicit standing-status field or deadline alert is shown. Missing for 10: webhook events for upcoming or lapsing deadlines, an explicit entity good-standing status endpoint, documented due-date fields on calendar entries, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can watch entity standing and filing deadlines through an API or webhook and raise them before they lapse

citations.quote: A company's compliance calendar lists the recurring obligations doola tracks to keep it in good standing.
